label: Classroom 019, DTU (building 352)
note: lecture room 019 in building 352 (classroom_readme.md), the room of dtu_room_019 (released with it), whose Readme gives 6.266 x 9.357 x 2.977 m; measured August 2019, before dtu_room_019 (2021), and the decay differs: T30 mid about 0.56 s here against 0.40-0.50 s at 500 Hz and 1 kHz in dtu_room_019's Readme; readme T60 about 0.5 s, Schroeder frequency 240 Hz; wooden floor, absorbing ceiling, windows with radiators on one long side; loudspeaker (Dynaudio BM6) in a corner; 4,761 points on a 1.7 x 1.7 m aperture at z = 1866 mm; IRs computed by inverse FFT of the published 1 Hz frequency responses (1 s at 10 kHz, content to 5 kHz; bins below 20 Hz are not measured data), analysed over the first 0.8 s because the level rises again over the last 0.15 s of each 1 s period (the inverse FFT is periodic); the levels have no stated unit
